image_description: A large, white blimp (non-rigid airship) with blue and red advertising graphics suspended indoors within a large hangar or exhibition hall. The envelope features prominent text 'MEET' and other logos. A small gondola is visible beneath the forward section. Two people are standing in the foreground looking up at the craft. The ceiling structure consists of metal trusses.
